sources.path: external local source: branding/DESIGN.md (not in repository)
sources.scope: Authoritative local WM palette and role-use guidance
Proposed catalog profiles and component families
Observed implementation and sampled source contracts

application_modes.preserve_reference: Retain pinned source colors, theme expressions, transforms and semantic encodings as evidenced.
application_modes.wm_current: Overlay WM tokens only onto explicitly bound presentation roles. Preserve status, actor, phase and data roles unless a separate semantic remap contract is supplied.
application_modes.rule: Mode selection is per component contract; no global hex replacement or automatic recoloring by color resemblance.

profiles.policy: Default white/grounded-blue pair; gray only for dense quiet structure.
Quiet content surface; must not be confused with data/status gray.
Bounded inverse region; validate each text/background pair.
Accent applies to small text or rules, never a generic background.
Sparing large callout/rule emphasis. If magenta is a fill, prefer grounded-blue ink; white is only for >=18pt regular or >=14pt bold.
Dedicated headline marker role only: 1-4 words, one line, >=20pt per source preview; never generic accent/surface/data.

rules: Resolve role to profile token to concrete color; bind only verified source object/property or run.
Unknown or inherited effective source colors remain unresolved; do not infer a target by matching RGB globally.
Presentation profile changes cannot mutate status, actor, phase, or data roles.
Preserve source geometry, theme expressions, alpha/tint transforms, and semantic legends unless explicitly adapted.

status.policy: Keep mappings family-specific and invariant under presentation profile changes; pair color with label/icon/pattern.

actor.policy: Retain actor mapping and generated legend in team compositions.

data.policy: Retain source ordering, legends and contrast; do not map by coincidence to brand accent tokens.

gauge_observed.policy: Verified source mapping from gauge-authoring.md and gauge-review.json; keep inactive and selected gray distinct.

implemented: internal/adapt/style.go accepts text.primary, text.secondary, surface, surface.muted, accent, state.active, state.inactive, border.
ResolveStyle implements neutral, subtle and inverse only; subtle surface is #F4F6FA.
Style.Ink selects a readable ink fallback; primary text versus surface is checked at 4.5:1.
Roadmap/comparison adaptors have family-specific status mappings; team composition requires a semantic-color legend.
Headline underline/highlight anchoring is implemented in cmd/pptxanchor and cmd/pptxtemplate/accents.go, with bounded source-backed evidence.
proposed_only_or_missing: Taxonomy blue-accent, magenta-accent and headline-highlight profiles are not universal runtime profiles.
No unified multibrand token registry or presentation-to-semantic namespace resolver.

Repository census supplied for this survey: 101 template contracts, 11 with roles/profiles; 124 source subcontracts, 20 with roles/profiles. Profile names include source, series_match, cool_emphasis, blue_emphasis and source accent profiles gray/navy/blue/pink (profile names alone do not establish gauge semantics).
Sample portable metric-card and pod-two source contracts have empty roles/profiles, although selected rollout contracts declare both.
No role-wide cross-contract policy validator or universal dynamic headline profile API; bounded headline anchoring is already implemented.
observed_conflicts: cards.go defaults numbered-card side rule to #0047FF, compatible with blue-as-small-emphasis; inspect other fills independently.
Adaptors use state.active as blue fill, but active may be information semantics and needs per-family classification.
Gauge selected gray #7F7F7F and inactive #CED7E6 are deliberately distinct; pink #F900D3 is verified source magenta.
Taxonomy inverse secondary is white; runtime inverse secondary is #CED7E6.
WM brand Light Gray #E8EEF8 differs from runtime subtle #F4F6FA.

priority_decisions: Adopt separate presentation/status/actor/data/phase role namespaces and explicit per-object/run bindings.
Distinguish preserve_reference contracts from wm_current branding overlays; apply brand roles only to explicitly bound presentation objects and leave data roles unchanged.
Classify current blue card and active fills by component family before changing any colors.
Preserve the verified gauge mapping and selected versus inactive gray distinction; any changed data palette requires an explicit overlay contract.
Align canonical WM tokens before promoting profiles; gate magenta and headline marker on contrast/geometry policy.
Keep source-preserving contracts explicitly distinct from adapted profile-enabled contracts.
